en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ays Bin Al Qasim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Ayesha said to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, ‘The people of Bareyra are stipulating their guardianship’. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The guardianship is for the one who emancipates’.
